character.description: vertically tileable waterlogged shipwreck obstacle fragments in drowned wood and oxidized teal

variants.action: four separate centered 40x32 vertical shipwreck obstacle tiles at equal scale, left to right: 1 broken bow plank cross-section, 2 exposed curved hull ribs, 3 damaged stern planks with oxidized bolt housing, 4 crossed mast-and-keel beams; every frame is one connected sturdy silhouette with compatible straight top and bottom edges for vertical repetition; no detached splinters, no animation, no labels, no floor, no coral or creatures

style: native 40x32 hard-edged pixel art with countable square pixels, one-pixel blue-black outline and a shared limited drowned brown-oxidized teal palette
